_why: Round 4 finding 9. Review state was written into prose in four documents, and prose does not update itself. handoff.md said round 3 had not run after round 3 had run and been fixed, and listed three of its findings as still open. decisions.md still had round 2 outstanding. The autonomous loop hands those files to a week-agent, which has no way to tell which sentence is current. So the state lives here, in one place, and check_docs.py fails any document that states it in prose.
